findings.question: indicator C1: Does the state operate its own government data centres that are in operation today?
findings.quote: From 1 July 2021, the Unified Data Centre (UDC) holds together the IT systems of the MLSI and the IT Systems of the newly established Deputy Ministry of Social Welfare (DMSW).
findings.value: yes: the Unified Data Centre (UDC) holds the IT systems of the MLSI and the DMSW
findings.title: CYPRUS 2025 Digital Public Administration Factsheet - Supporting document
findings.note: The 2025 edition replaces the 2024 supporting document, whose URL now returns 404. The same edition says the G-Cloud will run across two local government data centres.

review.reason: The Unified Data Centre holds the IT systems of two ministries, and the context shows systems migrated into it in 2021-2022 and a disaster-recovery site added in 2024, so it is a government-run data centre in operation.

findings.question: indicator C2: Is a national sovereign or government cloud platform in operation (not announced)?
findings.quote: Cyprus aims to establish a unified Government Cloud environment (G-Cloud) to provide cloud computing capabilities for the public sector by hosting governmental systems and services.
findings.value: no: the government cloud (G-Cloud) is still an aim, not an operating platform
findings.title: CYPRUS 2025 Digital Public Administration Factsheet - Supporting document
findings.note: The same section says the project is still in procurement, with contract sign-off expected in Q1 2026 and the first phase due by end 2026, so the printed 'Partly' looks too strong for a platform 'in operation'.

review.reason: The quote says Cyprus 'aims to establish' G-Cloud, and the context says the project is still in procurement, so it is not in operation.

findings.question: indicator K1: Is the root of the government's public key infrastructure or its qualified trust service operated by the state or a state-controlled body?
findings.quote: issued in February 2019 to JCC Payment Systems Ltd the first authorisation as qualified trust service provider. This qualified provider offers, in the Cyprus market, qualified electronic signatures and qualified electronic stamps
findings.value: partial: qualified trust services come from JCC Payment Systems Ltd, a provider authorised by the state
findings.title: CYPRUS 2025 Digital Public Administration Factsheet - Supporting document
findings.note: The state (the Department of Electronic Communications) supervises and keeps the trusted list; the QTSP itself is a company. The document does not state JCC's ownership, so a reviewer should confirm 'partial' against 'no'.

review.reason: The quote names JCC Payment Systems Ltd as the qualified trust service provider but does not say whether it is state-owned or state-controlled, so the indicator cannot be decided.

findings.question: indicator K2: Is the national electronic identity scheme operated by the state or a state-controlled body?
findings.quote: Moreover, in March 2022 the Department of Electronic Communications issued to JCC Payment Systems Ltd (qualified trust services provider) an authorisation to provide eID to Cypriot citizens.
findings.value: partial: eID is issued by JCC Payment Systems Ltd under state authorisation
findings.title: CYPRUS 2025 Digital Public Administration Factsheet - Supporting document
findings.note: Newer edition of the source. It also says CY Login is the government identity management system and that in January 2025 the state bought 100.000 eIDs from the national eID provider.

review.reason: The quote says JCC Payment Systems Ltd was authorised to provide eID, but it does not state that JCC is owned or controlled by the state, so the indicator is undetermined.

findings.question: Is the government's data classification scheme established in a statute or binding regulation? yes = Classification levels are defined in a statute or binding regulation; partial = Defined only in non-binding guidance or a circular; no = A source states there is no binding classification scheme
findings.quote: διαβαθμισμένες πληροφορίες της Δημοκρατίας και διαβαθμισμένες πληροφορίες της ΕΕ με διαβάθμιση «ΑΚΡΩΣ ΑΠΟΡΡΗΤΟ», «ΑΠΟΡΡΗΤΟ» και «ΕΜΠΙΣΤΕΥΤΙΚΟ» έχουν υποστεί σχετικό έλεγχο ασφάλειας
findings.quote_english: classified information of the Republic and EU classified information classified 'TOP SECRET', 'SECRET' and 'CONFIDENTIAL' have undergone the relevant security check
findings.title: Ο περί Κανόνων Ασφαλείας Διαβαθμισμένων Πληροφοριών, Εγγράφων και Υλικού και για Συναφή Θέματα Νόμος του 2021 (Ν. 84(I)/2021)
findings.publisher: National Security Authority (Εθνική Αρχή Ασφάλειας), Ministry of Defence
findings.note: Law 84(I)/2021 names the Republic's classification levels, from ΠΕΡΙΟΡΙΣΜΕΝΗΣ ΧΡΗΣΗΣ (RESTRICTED) up to ΑΚΡΩΣ ΑΠΟΡΡΗΤΟ. It was amended by Law 79(I)/2023, and both are published on the NSA's legislation page.

review.reason: The quote is from Law 84(I)/2021, a statute on the security of classified information, which names the classification levels ΑΚΡΩΣ ΑΠΟΡΡΗΤΟ, ΑΠΟΡΡΗΤΟ and ΕΜΠΙΣΤΕΥΤΙΚΟ (and ΠΕΡΙΟΡΙΣΜΕΝΗΣ ΧΡΗΣΗΣ elsewhere).
